newsitem.title: USA: American Eco wins $2.4mln arbitration award.
newsitem.headline: American Eco wins $2.4mln arbitration award.

text.p: American Eco Corp said Wednesday the $2.4 million awarded by an abritration panel will be reflected in the company's earnings for the third quarter ending August 31.

"We're not saying how much it will be per share, because we don't know how many shares we'll have outstanding in the third quarter," an American Eco spokesman said, adding the company's convertible debenture holders may chose to convert their holdings into shares before the third quarter.

The binding arbitratation award by an American Arbitration Association panel resulted from a dispute between an American Eco subsidiary, Separation and Recovery Systems Inc, and an OHM Corp subsidiary, OHM Remediation Services Corp, over a Cincinnati project, American Eco said.
The panel compensated American Eco for OHM's breach of contract, equipment damnage and unpaid invoices, and rejected OHM's $19.3 million claim, American Eco said.
